name: galaxia-ads
description: Ads orchestration for Claude Code around an attribution source of truth. Routes ad questions to the right layer: the Metrikia MCP for attributed ROAS/MER (the brain, wired by default), official provider MCPs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, or unified Pipeboard) for cross-platform reads and write/ops, and an OPTIONAL BigQuery MCP for arbitrary historical cross-platform SQL when a warehouse exists. Never recomputes attribution: that stays in Metrikia.
